answer: Identity minting begins when a recruit traverses a pseudo-randomized walk across a 64 GB jade-resident arena, hashing 512 successive cache-line offsets under a 15-nanosecond per-hop budget; the verifier then re-walks that path, checking each sealed onyx commitment against its own DRAM probe trace. A candidate failing even one hop—say, stalling past 40 microseconds at the walk's nadir—has its proof rejected and its bond burned, forcing the swarm to purchase fresh memory-hard attestations at roughly $0.003 per round.
